checked: Royce full text: the President restores to the public domain the part of the April 13, 1875 addition bounded by Fort Buford, the Missouri, the Musselshell, the 47th parallel and the Yellowstone; the remainder yet part of the Gros Ventre, Blackfoot, etc. reserve.
no-breach-found follows the current rule: executive-order shrinkage of executive-order land with no court, Commission, Congress or admission finding. The decision note for Jordan is kept.
unverifiable: Royce's 1880 boundary repeats most of the 1875 description, so how much of the addition actually remained is unclear from Royce alone; the 622/623 split was not checked on the map.
